forbiddenActions: Do not implement repository mutation, target CAS behavior, local Git adapter behavior, checkpoint persistence, result normalization, traceability, SystemVerification, or BusinessAcceptance.
Do not change package metadata, exports, baselines, dogfood gate artifacts, unrelated modules, or generic Core behavior.
Do not create approval, verification, integration, graph, or progression facts.
Do not create commits, tags, pull requests, or merge any branch.

requiredCorrections: Use exactly integrated, integration-conflict, baseline-drift, unable-to-proceed, and execution-failed as module outcomes; remove conflict and target-drift.
Add the Core-owned checkpoint/recovery step before result validation in the module orchestration plan.
Use only filesystem.read, filesystem.write, network.connect, process.spawn, and secrets.read permission-demand kinds with bounded scopes; do not invent repository permission kinds.

Use immutable native integration effect and post-state evidence for runtime integrated outcomes; keep change-integration/contract-tests only as work-item verification evidence, not module runtime evidence.
Make IntegrationPlan explicitly bind exact verified change bytes/digest, pre-state, adapter version/configuration, bounded permission demands, target transition, policy, and idempotency identity.

Allow RawIntegrationEffectResult and IntegrationCheckpoint to faithfully represent operation details, interruption, uncertain effects, prepared/effect-recorded/reconciled states, and recovery without claiming non-success mutation is already resolved.
Add negative tests for every corrected boundary and retain unknown-field, substitution, downstream-authority, and exact-digest rejection.

handoffContract.format: Return one exact JSON object with fields workItemId, outcome, summary, changedFiles, verification, deliverables, sourceRefs, residualRisks, and integrationNotes.
